newsitem.title: USA: Buffton sets Q3 $335,000 reserve for note.
newsitem.headline: Buffton sets Q3 $335,000 reserve for note.

text.p: Buffton Corp said Tuesday it will reserve $335,000 during its third quarter ending June 30 for a note from Depot Inc because it believes collection of the debt is now in doubt.

Robert McLean, chief executive officer, said in a statement that Depot, which bought one of Buffton's entertainment facilities in New Orleans, was apparently experiencing fire code and structural problems with the facility.
He said Depot has informed Buffton that the company is unable to presently continue principal and interest payments on the note.

"Discussions with the principals of Depot have led us to believe that collection of the note is now in doubt," he said, adding that Buffton will be working with Depot in an effort to restructure the note.
